label: p100_final_rq3a

condition_definitions.no_safety: same architecture but specialist output bypasses safety
condition_definitions.no_persona: same full architecture but explicit persona/style wording removed

runtime: self-hosted GPU inference on university infrastructure
candidate_inputs: I completed a master's in Data Science and worked on several academic projects.
I mainly use Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn.
I have implemented classification, anomaly detection and machine learning models.
I clean missing values, remove duplicates and inspect inconsistent observations.
I evaluate models using precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC and cross-validation.
I create visualizations with matplotlib and Power BI and explain results to stakeholders.
I completed real-world projects involving preprocessing, modelling and evaluation.
I collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues and communicate findings clearly.
I normally define the problem, inspect the data, test alternatives and validate the result.
My goal is to become a strong applied data scientist and work on useful real-world systems.
execution_order_method: cycle through all six permutations of the three conditions
latency_metric: backend_response_ready_ms = elapsed wall-clock time from graph invocation to returned response; excludes ASR and TTS
behavioral_contract: non-empty response + expected question-unit count + <=30 words
strict_contract: behavioral contract + exactly one final ||| separator
notes: RQ1 and RQ2 frozen; no RQ1/RQ2 experiment is rerun.
Safety conditions retain raw specialist response and final repaired response.
No-safety condition exposes specialist output directly.
Persona ablation changes only explicit persona/style wording; task/output constraints remain.
